description.text: The fourth Scarlet & Violet set, released on 3 November 2023 with 266 cards: 182 and 84 secret rares. It brought in Paradox Pokémon as Ancient and Future cards, Pokémon and Trainers alike: Ancient Pokémon such as Roaring Moon ex and Sandy Shocks ex tend to hit hard and be hard to Knock Out, while Future Pokémon such as Iron Valiant ex and Iron Hands ex have extra effects for craftier play. Gholdengo ex and Armarouge ex are among its other Pokémon ex, and Garchomp ex appears as a Water-type Tera Pokémon.
